snippet.title: Reciprocity: The Liminal Void - Official Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the Gameplay Reveal Trailer for Reciprocity: The Liminal Void, a first-person psychological horror game developed by Kailvvveit. Players will explore a liminal world to keep their distance from a sinister entity. Upgrade gear, sell items, and escape at all costs in Reciprocity: The Liminal Void, coming soon to PC (Steam).
